text: Jumapili, Jumatatu, Jumanne na Jumatano zina namba mbili hadi tano. Ni siku ipi basi inayohesabiwa ya kwanza?
gloss: Sunday (pili=2), Monday (tatu=3), Tuesday (nne=4), Wednesday (tano=5) carry the numbers two to five. Which day counts as the first? — Saturday, Jumamosi: "mosi" means one.

text: Chagua neno linalofaa: “Kitabu ___ ni kipya.”
gloss: Choose the right word: "My book ___ is new." — changu: kitabu is in the ki-/vi- class, so the possessive takes ch-.

text: Maneno haya yote yanatokana na kitenzi “andika”. Lipi ni jina la mtu?
gloss: All these words come from the verb "andika" (write). Which one names a person? — Mwandishi (writer): the m-/wa- prefix marks people; the others mean writings, handwriting, a text.

text: Rafiki yako akisema “Nitakuja kesho kutwa”, atakuja baada ya siku ngapi kuanzia leo?
gloss: If a friend says "I will come kesho kutwa", in how many days from today? — Two days: kesho kutwa is the day after tomorrow.

text: Neno lipi kati ya haya halibadiliki likiwa katika wingi?
gloss: Which of these words stays the same in the plural? — Ndizi (banana): N-class, ndizi/ndizi; the others become watoto, vitabu, macho.

text: Mtoto akimsalimu mzee kwa kusema “Shikamoo”, mzee hujibu nini?
gloss: A child greets an elder with "Shikamoo"; what does the elder answer? — Marahaba, the fixed reply to shikamoo.

text: Katika hadithi za wanyama za Kiswahili, ni mnyama yupi mdogo anayewashinda wakubwa kwa ujanja wake?
gloss: In Swahili animal tales, which small animal outwits the big ones? — The hare (Sungura), the classic trickster; the hyena is usually the greedy fool.

text: Rangi ipi haimo kwenye bendera ya Tanzania?
gloss: Which colour is not on the flag of Tanzania? — Red: the flag is green, yellow (gold), black and blue.

text: Watani wa jadi wa klabu ya Simba SC ya Dar es Salaam ni klabu gani?
gloss: Who are the traditional rivals of Simba SC of Dar es Salaam? — Yanga (Young Africans): their matches are the Kariakoo derby.

text: Muziki wa taarab, wenye ala kama udi na kanuni, ulistawi zaidi wapi?
gloss: Where did taarab music, with instruments like the oud and qanun, flourish most? — Zanzibar, the home of taarab orchestras such as Ikhwani Safaa.

text: Jina “Tanzania” liliundwa kwa kuunganisha majina ya maeneo mawili. Ni yapi?
gloss: The name "Tanzania" was made by joining two names. Which? — Tanganyika and Zanzibar, united in 1964.

text: Mgonjwa anayeharisha hunywa ORS, mchanganyiko wa maji, chumvi na sukari. Hii huzuia nini hasa?
gloss: Someone with diarrhoea drinks ORS, water with salt and sugar. What does it prevent? — Dehydration.

text: Kwenye WhatsApp, vema mbili za rangi ya bluu chini ya ujumbe zinamaanisha nini?
gloss: On WhatsApp, what do two blue ticks under a message mean? — The message has been read (grey ticks mean sent/delivered).

text: Nambari ya siri ya OTP unayotumiwa kwa SMS inaweza kutumika mara ngapi?
gloss: How many times can an OTP code sent by SMS be used? — Only once: OTP means one-time password.

text: Harry Potter alisomea uchawi katika shule gani?
gloss: At which school did Harry Potter study magic? — Hogwarts; the others are other wizarding schools of the same books.

text: Katika filamu za “Toy Story”, mwanasesere mwenye kofia ya mchunga ng’ombe anaitwa nani?
gloss: In the Toy Story films, what is the toy with the cowboy hat called? — Woody (Buzz is the spaceman, Rex the dinosaur, Hamm the piggy bank).

text: Katika mpira wa kikapu, mpira ukirushwa kikapuni kutoka nje ya mstari wa nusu duara, timu hupata pointi ngapi?
gloss: In basketball, how many points for a basket thrown from outside the arc? — 3.

text: Dagaa waliokaushwa juani hukaa muda mrefu bila kuoza. Kwa nini?
gloss: Sun-dried dagaa (sardines) keep for a long time without rotting. Why? — Microbes that spoil food need water, and drying removes it.

text: Programu ya simu ya Boomplay hutumiwa hasa kwa ajili ya nini?
gloss: What is the Boomplay phone app mainly used for? — Listening to music (streaming and downloads).

text: Wamakonde wa kusini mwa Tanzania na kaskazini mwa Msumbiji wanajulikana sana kwa sanaa gani?
gloss: The Makonde of southern Tanzania and northern Mozambique are famous for which art? — Wood carving (vinyago), often in African blackwood (mpingo).

text: Kwa nini haifai kuweka sahani yenye mapambo ya chuma ndani ya maikrowevu?
gloss: Why should a plate with metal decoration not go into a microwave? — It can spark: microwaves induce currents in the metal.

text: Bisi hutengenezwa kwa kukaanga punje za zao gani hadi zipasuke?
gloss: Bisi (popcorn) is made by heating kernels of which crop until they burst? — Maize.

text: Kwenye pakiti ya dawa, maandishi “EXP” yanaonyesha nini?
gloss: On a medicine pack, what does "EXP" show? — The expiry date, after which it should not be used.

text: Ukiwasha “Airplane mode” kwenye simu, nini huzimwa?
gloss: Turning on "Airplane mode" on a phone switches off what? — Its radio connections: the mobile network (calls, data) and, by default, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

text: Mwili wa binadamu hutoa jasho hasa ili kufanya nini?
gloss: Why does the human body mainly sweat? — To cool itself: evaporating sweat carries heat away (the "detox" idea is a myth).

text: Kisiwa cha Pemba kinajulikana duniani kwa kilimo cha zao gani?
gloss: The island of Pemba is known worldwide for growing which crop? — Cloves (karafuu), most of Zanzibar's clove harvest.

text: Alama © kwenye kitabu au filamu inaonyesha nini?
gloss: What does the sign © on a book or film show? — Copyright.

text: Mbuyu hustahimili kiangazi kirefu kwa kuhifadhi nini ndani ya shina lake nene?
gloss: The baobab survives long dry seasons by storing what in its thick trunk? — Water.

text: Mwalimu akiwasalimu wanafunzi “Hamjambo?”, wote kwa pamoja hujibu nini?
gloss: A teacher greets the pupils "Hamjambo?" (are you all well?). What do they answer together? — Hatujambo: plural "you" is answered with plural "we".

text: Nchini Kenya na Tanzania, magari huendeshwa upande wa kushoto wa barabara. Usukani huwa upande gani wa gari?
gloss: In Kenya and Tanzania cars drive on the left. Which side is the steering wheel? — The right: the driver sits on the side nearer the centre of the road.

text: Juu ya mlima mrefu, maji huchemka kabla ya kufikia nyuzi 100 °C. Kwa nini?
gloss: High up a mountain, water boils below 100 °C. Why? — Air pressure is lower, so water boils at a lower temperature.

text: Kila mwaka makundi makubwa ya nyumbu huvuka mto gani wenye mamba, kati ya Serengeti na Kenya?
gloss: Every year huge herds of wildebeest cross which crocodile river between the Serengeti and Kenya? — The Mara River, in the Great Migration.

text: Mwanamuziki Diamond Platnumz ndiye mwanzilishi wa lebo gani?
gloss: Which label did singer Diamond Platnumz found? — WCB Wasafi; Konde Gang is Harmonize's, Kings Music Alikiba's, Sol Generation Sauti Sol's.

text: Mwigizaji Lupita Nyong’o alishinda tuzo ya Oscar kupitia filamu gani?
gloss: For which film did Lupita Nyong'o win her Oscar? — 12 Years a Slave (Best Supporting Actress, 2014); she also acted in the other three.

text: Riwaya “Kusadikika” na “Kufikirika” ziliandikwa na nani?
gloss: Who wrote the novels "Kusadikika" and "Kufikirika"? — Shaaban Robert.

text: Mkenya David Rudisha alishinda dhahabu mbili za Olimpiki katika mbio za mita ngapi?
gloss: Kenyan David Rudisha won two Olympic golds over what distance? — 800 m (London 2012, Rio 2016).

text: Antibiotiki hazisaidii kutibu ugonjwa upi kati ya haya?
gloss: Antibiotics do not help treat which of these? — The flu/common cold, caused by viruses; TB, cholera and typhoid are bacterial.

text: Nembo ya “swoosh”, inayofanana na alama ya vema, ni ya kampuni gani?
gloss: The "swoosh" logo, shaped like a tick, belongs to which company? — Nike.

text: Mwaka 1961 alikuwa binadamu wa kwanza kusafiri hadi anga za juu. Ni nani?
gloss: In 1961 he became the first human in space. Who? — Yuri Gagarin, aboard Vostok 1.

text: Mlango-bahari wa Gibraltar unaitenganisha Hispania na nchi gani?
gloss: The Strait of Gibraltar separates Spain from which country? — Morocco.

text: Sushi ya Kijapani mara nyingi huviringishwa kwa jani jembamba la nini?
gloss: Japanese sushi is often rolled in a thin sheet of what? — Seaweed (nori).

text: Ukimweka mtu kwenye “Bcc” ya barua pepe, nani hataiona anwani yake?
gloss: If you put someone in the "Bcc" of an email, who will not see their address? — The other recipients (blind carbon copy).

text: Msemo ulioandikwa kwenye kanga, mara nyingi methali au ujumbe, huitwaje?
gloss: What is the saying printed on a kanga called? — Its "jina" (name); pindo is the border, mji the centre, leso another word for the cloth itself.

text: Katika Kiswahili sanifu, mkazo wa sauti kwa kawaida huwa kwenye silabi ipi ya neno?
gloss: In standard Swahili, which syllable of a word normally takes the stress? — The penultimate: ba-RA-bara, ki-TA-bu; saying any word shows it.

text: Reli iliyopewa jina la utani “Lunatic Express” ilianza kujengwa mwaka 1896 kutoka mji gani?
gloss: The railway nicknamed the "Lunatic Express" began to be built in 1896 from which town? — Mombasa; it reached Kisumu on Lake Victoria in 1901.

text: Bitcoin ilianzishwa mwaka 2009 na mtu anayejulikana kwa jina gani la bandia?
gloss: Bitcoin was launched in 2009 by someone known under which pseudonym? — Satoshi Nakamoto (Buterin created Ethereum; Finney and Szabo were early figures).

text: Sifuri kamili (0 K), joto la chini kabisa linalowezekana, ni takriban nyuzi ngapi za Selsiasi?
gloss: Absolute zero (0 K), the lowest possible temperature, is about how many degrees Celsius? — −273 °C (−273.15; −459 is the Fahrenheit figure).

text: Ukisimama kwenye Ncha ya Kaskazini kabisa, popote unapotazama ni upande gani wa dira?
gloss: Standing exactly on the North Pole, which compass direction do you face whichever way you look? — South: every direction away from the pole is south.

text: Utenzi wa Mwana Kupona (1858) ni mawaidha ya mshairi huyo kwa nani?
gloss: The Utendi of Mwana Kupona (1858) is the poet's advice to whom? — Her daughter, Mwana Hashima.

text: Mmisionari gani Mjerumani aliandika sarufi ya kwanza ya Kiswahili mwaka 1850?
gloss: Which German missionary wrote the first grammar of Swahili in 1850? — Johann Ludwig Krapf ("Outline of the Elements of the Kisuáheli Language"); Rebmann was his colleague, Steere and Velten came later.
